recentItems.title: Members of 9/11 community share stories of grief and hope 25 years after attacks
recentItems.description:
Friday marks 25 years since the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks that killed nearly 3,000 people. Survivors, responders and families of the victims spoke with CBS News about their memories of that day and its impact on their lives a quarter-century later.

#news #911attacks #history

7:58 Stephen Siller Jr., son of NYC firefighter who died on 9/11

16:51 Julie Lewis, widow of banker killed in attacks
19:01 Caroline Lewis, Julie's daughter
21:14 Kathe Conlon, first responder
25:43 Elizabeth Miller and Jessica Trant, whose fathers died on 9/11
